name: Agent Memory Store
summary: Session transcripts, summarization compaction, and retrieval for LLM agents — so a long conversation stays inside the context window.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: MEMORY_COMPACT_AT_TOKENS
env.description: Running token total at which the oldest turns are summarized. Should sit well below your model's window, leaving room for retrieval and the response.

env.name: MEMORY_KEEP_RECENT_TURNS
env.description: Turns always kept verbatim, never compacted. Recent exchanges carry the most relevant detail.

env.name: MEMORY_SUMMARY_MODEL
env.description: Model used to summarize compacted turns.

env.name: MEMORY_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Must stay consistent, or retrieval across a session is comparing incomparable vectors.

env.name: MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
env.description: Must match the model and the vector column width.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Compact sessions that have crossed the token threshold. Scheduled rather than inline so a user-facing turn never waits on a summarization call.

operations.title: POST /turns
operations.description: Append a turn and update the running token total.

operations.title: GET /context
operations.description: Assemble context: summaries, retrieved turns, recent turns.

operations.title: POST /compact
operations.description: Cron. Summarize the oldest turns of oversized sessions.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
